title: Release set fixed, movable Hand label
notes: Updater: releases now always come with a SIXTH file, update.json, which older app shells read (its absence caused "update.json has no version"). The release script bundles all six files into one zip and the update window names the missing file.

The small Hand label (count and Key) can be dragged anywhere on the table; its place is remembered and double-clicking puts it back. The Sort button is gone: drag cards sideways in the hand to order them.
